Ever wondered where to find a list of all the subverses, or which ones you're subscribed to? There's several ways to see!

In the very top menu bar, on the far left side, simply hover on "My Subverses" and all you've subscribed to will appear! The first option down will take you to the page where you can "Edit Your Subscriptions".

Other ways to get to subverses:

  • From any of the Front, All, or Default pages, look in the right sidebar and click the "Explore Voat" button, or
  • Type "https://voat.co/subverses" into your address bar

Once you're on the page, click buttons to see the most Popular (by subscriber count), the most Active (by posting count), New ones (recently created), the ones to which you're Subscribed (alphabetically), or you can do a Search to locate subverses here at Voat. Why not create a new subverse from while you're in here (but be sure to post right away and add a description to your sidebar or it will disappear)!

There have been a few instances where mods have gotten a little too big for their britches and the community has come out roaring with torches and pitchforks LOL.
